metadata.title: Black hole mass of central galaxies and cluster mass correlation in cosmological hydro-dynamical simulations

notes: No eligible Galactic unbound stars are present. The paper studies simulated central supermassive black holes, BCGs, groups, and clusters (e.g., T:p12-b3), not individual Milky Way stars. The “unbound stars” mentioned at T:p9-b11 and T:p13-b6 are simulated intra-cluster light stars in cosmological clusters, not Galactic unbound candidates. No star identifiers are supplied.
